# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 68 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 68

**1** Jesus said: "Blessed are you when you are hated and persecuted. And no place will be found where you have been persecuted."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Parallel to Matthew 5:11, Luke 6:22; but Thomas's second clause is unique and enigmatic
- "No place will be found where you have been persecuted" — the persecution leaves no trace, no residue; it is undone
- Alternative reading: the persecution has no location in which to take root (i.e., you are beyond the world's reach)
- The beatitude formula without the Matthean elaboration ("for my sake")
- The promise is cryptic; it may refer to the transcendence of the persecuted self beyond worldly location
